label: For "Urban Flood Risk Forecasting": Forecast street-level flood risk from rainfall forecasts, drainage state and river levels so the city can pre-position pumps, close roads and warn residents in time. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Rainfall thresholds only.
